source_semantics.fact: EPSG:4326 lon/lat coordinates are projected with std::round onto integer world coordinates at zoom 32.
Before line simplification at z, remove_noop is called with shift=32-z-line_detail; here z=12,line_detail=12, so shift=8.
remove_noop groups each coordinate by std::round(coord / 2^shift), dropping a LINETO equal to the previous rounded coordinate. C++ std::round rounds exact half ties away from zero.
Tile assembly requires a nonzero LINETO for a line and omits empty geometry.

target_coordinate_calculation.result: Both vertices map to the same z12 world pixel [8947849,5065437] and local tile pixel [2185,2781]; Tippecanoe removes the part as a no-op. NumPy rint instead ties the x=8947848.5 endpoint to even 8947848, predicting a surviving one-pixel segment.
